rooms.name: Vortex's Room
rooms.desc:
This room is in the shape of a hexagon. The ceiling towers many feet over
your head. Within the room there is a large desk with many books lying 
jumbled all over it. Off in one of the corners lies a trail backpack and
some camping gear. In another corner lies some piantball gear. The walls 
are covered in beautiful paintings of dragons which seem to move around at
their own will.

rooms.name: Entrance Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The lush vegitation of the surrounding area slowly vanishes as the 
trail you stand on ends at large hole in the mountainside,  Peering
within the hole you can hear and feel a strong wind flowing outward;
its force nearly enough to drive you back.
   The only exits from this area lead down the trail or into the hole,
though the trail looks far more inviting.

rooms.name: Inside the cave
rooms.desc:
The wind seems to increase for a moment as you step from the trail
onto the hard rock surface of the cave floor.  Listening closely, you 
think the wind may be saying something.
   The walls here, like the mountain itself, are made of a dark granite
that seems to pulse as you stare at it.  
   Above you, the cave steeps sharply upward, leading to the outside,
while to the north, the cave leads deeper into the mountain.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The last traces of light are left behind as you enter this section of the
tunnel.  Behind you, you can see the light at the end of the tunnel move
further away as you work your way deeper into the darkness.  The walls and
floor here seem to level out while scuffmarks on the floor indicate that
this place may have been visited frequently.
   The tunnels leads to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The floor gradually slopes downward as the walls smooth out to form
a refined corridor.  Scuffs from boots and scratches from weapon mar
the cave floor, evidence that this part of the cave gets quite alot of
use.
   It looks as though the cave ends to the north, where it dead-ends 
against a flat granite wall.  As you examine the granite, you notice
strange runes carved into it.
   The tunnel leads to the south, away from the runes.

rooms.name: Entrance passage
rooms.desc:
The passage behind you vanishes, leaving you staring into abysmal 
darkness.  All around you, the walls pulse with a inner power as it
absorbs the light from your source.  The floor is flat and smooth,
still marred with traffic while the walls bear sconces with unlit
torches.
   A thin layer of dust covers the floor, still bearing the prints
of recent passage.  The prints lead to the west.

rooms.name: A Long Passage
rooms.desc:
A passage spreads out before you, a large mosaic pattern etched into
the stone-tiled floor.  Faint light emanates from the between the tiles,
casting an eerie luminescence about the area.  The shadows cast by your
own movements makes the walls appear to move and sway.
   The passage leads to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Small Chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small room with a very high ceiling.  The chamber
stretches some fifteen feet in diameter and upon every inch of the
curved wall cryptic symbols symbols have been etched.
   In the center of the room, a small dias holds a marble statue
of a regal woman.  Her long, waving hair cascades down her stone
back in sheets while her hands rise above her in a gesture of
worship.
   Corridors lead off from this chamber in all directions, the
sounds of whispers and wind coming from the north.

rooms.name: A Narrow Passage
rooms.desc:
The dark black rock walls seem to seep the light from your source as
you traverse this passage.  Natural in origin, the walls are rough and
the floor uneven as you stumble unsteadily through it.
   The walls slowly press closer together as you head north while the
exit to the south leads to some sort of chamber.

rooms.name: A Long Hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand in the center of a long, arched corridor.  The walls here,
obviously carved by a craftsman bear scenes and symbols of combat and
magic.  Small, canteloupe-sized holes rest in the walls just above the
floors of the corridor and appear to by symmetrically spaced at three
feet apart.
   The floor here is littered with all races of skeletons in varying
stages of decomposition while around them, broken weapons, armor, and
other equipment lies scattered about.

rooms.name: Dark Chasm
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a deep chasm.  The black, light-absorbing rock
surrounds you as you strain to peer into the gaping abyss.  From what little
light escapes your source, the chasm walls extend indefinitely below you.
   To the east lies a fatal fall into the the abyss while to the west, the
corridor leads into darkness.

rooms.name: Bottomless Chasm
rooms.desc:
As you step off the edge of the chasm into the inky darkness you pray 
something stops you from the really long fall that awaits you.
But
   you
      seem 
          to
            keep 
                falling
                       and
                          falling
                                 and 
                                    falling
                                           and
                                              falling
                                                     and
                                                        falling
                                                               and
                                                                  falling.

And just as you think you may keep falling forever you hit the ground with
a loud splat.

rooms.name: A Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
Upon entering this hallway a vast sense of lonliness assualts you. The 
feelings of death and longing are etched into your every step. The walls 
channel you in a westernly direction with the ground beneath your feet ever
so slightly grading downward. The walls here seem to swirl with an inner power
and from within the sounds of faint voices can be heard.
   The only exits from this room are to the east and west.
